name: Calder Vey
role: Primary suspect connected to the covert reactivation of Kallis Foundry
canon_observations: Present at Kallis Foundry during the Third Measure operation.
Used or permitted use of a tracked transponder pattern that complicated positive identification.
Demonstrated awareness of the Ranger drone net and looked directly into a concealed Mote sensor.
Escaped immediate Ranger custody during the emergency recall.
Was associated with restricted reactor material and specialized fabrication activity at the foundry.
Appears to have known that the Dark Star incident or related fleet arrival was imminent.
staging_hypotheses: Calder Vey was manufacturing a replacement Silence artifact.
Calder Vey possesses direct knowledge of the earlier Marshal investigation.
Calder Vey is aligned with the Shadow Fleet.
Calder Vey caused or intended the dark star containment failure.
